title: Verify removing a fee/discount uses Create and Edit, not a separate Delete permission
custom_preconds:
1. You are logged in as a role that HAS Work Orders: Create & Edit and See Financial Data but does NOT have a separate 'Delete' permission.
  2. An open work order with a whole-work-order fee/discount.
custom_steps:
1. Open the entry's ⋮ menu on the 'WO Fees & Discounts' card.
  2. Check that a 'Remove' option is present and works.
  3. Remove the fee/discount.
custom_expected:
1. The 'Remove' option is available and works even though you do not have a separate Delete permission.
  2. The fee/discount is removed.
  3. By contrast, a user without Create & Edit sees no 'Remove' option and cannot remove it.
